pages.quiz:
COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

2. Which statement about Negotiation Skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Negotiation Skills as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Negotiation Skills.
   C. Say Negotiation Skills never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2..
   C. Explain Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   B. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   C. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   C. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

7. Which statement about Advocacy in the School Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the School Community never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the School Community.
   D. Treat Advocacy in the School Community as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im as rumours only.
   B. Say Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im.
   D. Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Building Consensus is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Building Consensus as rumours only.
   C. Say Building Consensus never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Building Consensus.

12. Which statement about Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr.
   D. Treat Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Nurturing Empathy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Negotiation Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Consensus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Plan income and spending wisely

2. D — Explain Negotiation Skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. C — Explain Leadership Development 1.4 Intercultural Competence 2.0 Life Skills Education 2. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A — Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Nairobi

7. B — Explain Advocacy in the School Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. A — Explain symbols used on a map

9. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. D — Explain Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Building Consensus with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. A — Explain Problem Identification Process 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entr with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Nurturing Empathy; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Negotiation Skills; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Building Consensus 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Identification Process 3.2 Im; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Building Consensus; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
